desc:
✨ Welcome to the world of Hexe! ✨

Brew wacky potions, discover new powers and explore Hexe,  from the lively and bustling Hexe town square to the outskirts and the spooky Forest and Swamp.

Every power changes how you play. Push, pull and resize objects, slash through obstacles, blast through walls and dash past hazards to solve puzzles and find hidden ingredients.

How much magic can you learn and master?

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🎮 Controls

Mouse Button - Teleknesis
F - Push
X - Slash
Z - Surround
T - Resize
C - Magic Blast
Shift - Dash
Space - Jump / Fly

B - Index
H - Home
J - Call Mount
G - Backpack
M - Map
K - Photo Mode
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

This experience is an advertisement for Disney’s Hexed.
